message.content:
Please train a fasttext model on the yelp data in the data/ folder.

The final model size needs to be less than 150MB but get at least 0.62 accuracy on a private test set that comes from the same yelp review distribution.

The model should be saved as /app/model.bin

[tool_use Bash] ls /app/data/ && head -5 /app/data/* 2>/dev/null | head -40
[tool_use Bash] wc -l /app/data/*
[tool_use Bash] which fasttext; pip list 2>/dev/null | grep -i fast; dpkg -l | grep fasttext 2>/dev/null

[tool_use Bash] pip install fasttext-wheel pyarrow --quiet 2>&1 | tail -3
[tool_use Bash] python3 -c "
import pyarrow.parquet as pq
t = pq.read_table('/app/data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet')
print(t.schema)
print(t.num_rows)
print(t.to_pandas().head(3))
"
